method: release (no LTO), one pinned core, ABBA rounds of native/unified legs; each sample is one complete immutable write; setup, open and output-byte equality checks outside the timer; pair ratio = unified/native per round, median reported
machine_note: shared 32-core host with concurrent agents (load average 11-16 during runs); absolute medians were bimodal across processes (e.g. 276/401 us for one native path), so before/after absolute times are not compared, only pair ratios
